rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Fribourg; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Fribourg; other communes in Fribourg set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Fribourg; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier: note
rows.value: Income tax 0.96 (wealth tax 1.00); Fribourg city: income 0.80 (wealth 0.80); church: income 0.09 reformed, 0.06 Catholic (wealth 0.10 and 0.18)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Fribourg; other communes in Fribourg set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
